Name: Online shopping
Author: K1riko87
Description:
在农场放一台网购电脑，就能选购已解锁商店当天出售的商品，让快递员送到农舍门口。

安装后首次进入存档的当天，京东快递员会上门介绍配送服务，并免费送你一台电脑。回到农舍附近就能与他见面；如果当时不在家，来访会等你回来。每个存档赠送一次，联机时由房主领取。需要更多电脑，也可以到罗宾的木匠店购买。

只要商店当天营业，就可以全天在电脑上下单。旅行货车和书商也会在到访日开放网购，商品仍受季节、库存和解锁条件限制。火山商店需要你到过火山五层，并学会矮人语；旧存档安装后需要重新到达五层一次。

商品沿用原商店的价格和交换要求，配送费根据商店所在区域有所不同，火山商人的费用最高。付款前可以在购物车核对费用。收到包裹后，在农舍门口领取即可；背包装不下的商品会留在包裹里。

其他 Mod 加入已支持商店的新商品会自动出现在电脑中。部分新增商店需要当天先到店查看商品，之后才能网购；使用特殊交易方式的商店可能需要单独适配。动物购买、工具升级和建筑施工等服务仍需到现场办理。

支持鼠标和手柄操作。联机时，房主和农场助手都需要安装相同版本，各自领取自己的订单。中文版采用京东主题，英文版采用 Amazon 主题，两版玩法相同。

English:

Place a shopping computer on your farm, browse today's goods from unlocked shops, and have a courier deliver your order to the farmhouse.

On the first day you load a save after installation, an Amazon courier visits to introduce the service and give you a free computer. Head back to the farmhouse to meet them. If you're away, the visit waits until you return. Each save receives one free computer, collected by the host in multiplayer. Robin sells extras if you need them.

Shops accept online orders all day on days they operate. The Traveling Cart and Bookseller are also available on their visiting days. Seasonal stock, limited quantities, and shop unlock requirements still apply. To order from the Volcano Dwarf, you must have reached floor five and learned Dwarvish. Existing saves need another floor-five visit after installing the mod.

Goods keep their original prices and barter requirements. Delivery fees vary by shop location, with the Volcano Dwarf charging the most. Review the costs in your cart before paying, then collect your parcel outside the farmhouse. Anything that won't fit in your inventory stays in the parcel.

Items added to supported shops by other mods appear on the computer automatically. Some new shops require an in-person visit to browse their stock that day before you can order online. Shops with custom trading systems may need separate compatibility support. Services such as buying animals, upgrading tools, and constructing buildings still require an in-person visit.

Mouse and controller controls are supported. In multiplayer, the host and farmhands must install the same version, and each player collects their own orders. The English edition uses an Amazon theme, while the Chinese edition uses a JD theme. Both editions play the same way.
